req.title: Update task
req.statement: The system shall update mutable fields of the task and return the updated object when PUT /tasks/{task_id} is called with a valid body.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the update functionality of the task management API. It includes tests for positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage. The positive test verifies that a valid update request returns the expected result. The negative test checks that invalid input is correctly rejected. The boundary test ensures that edge cases, such as maximum string lengths, are handled properly.

tests.name: test_update_task_positive
preconditions: Task with id 1 exists in the database
actions: Send PUT request to /tasks/1 with valid update data
expected: Updated task object returned with new values
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

update_data = {
    "title": "Read chapter 6",
    "description": "Updated description",
    "completed": False
}

response = client.put("/tasks/1", json=update_data)
assert response.status_code == 200
updated_task = response.json()
assert updated_task["title"] == "Read chapter 6"
assert updated_task["description"] == "Updated description"
assert updated_task["completed"] is False

tests.name: test_update_task_negative
preconditions: Task with id 1 exists in the database
actions: Send PUT request to /tasks/1 with invalid update data
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

invalid_update_data = {
    "title": "",
    "description": "Updated description",
    "completed": False
}

response = client.put("/tasks/1", json=invalid_update_data)
assert response.status_code == 422
assert "detail" in response.json()

tests.name: test_update_task_boundary
preconditions: Task with id 1 exists in the database
actions: Send PUT request to /tasks/1 with boundary-valid update data
expected: Updated task object returned with new values
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

boundary_update_data = {
    "title": "X" * 100,
    "description": "X" * 500,
    "completed": True
}

response = client.put("/tasks/1", json=boundary_update_data)
assert response.status_code == 200
updated_task = response.json()
assert updated_task["title"] == "X" * 100
assert updated_task["description"] == "X" * 500
assert updated_task["completed"] is True
